source: docs/specs/06_events/04_endings.md: the eight ending news events (zin_world.100 to .107) and the end screen (zin_world.110 to .112). They live in events/zin_world_endings.txt; events/zin_world.txt belongs to the world module. The news options carry the holder's ending spirit (spirit, holder).

events.title: The Lost Cause
events.external: zin_world_reach_ending fires it to every country (major news event) when the Lost Cause ending is reached
events.desc: The Fourth Age ends with a king of Aen's line on the throne of Aenor. The Lost Cause that a vain king founded for his own glory has become something else: the league of the living, who stood together against the dark and asked no crown to kneel. The Middle Lands lie in ruins. [zin_loc_ending_lost_cause_cost]

events.title: Children of Volgan
events.external: zin_world_reach_ending fires it to every country when Children of Volgan is reached
events.desc: In this telling of the age, the Great Spirit of the Dead Lands rules a ruined world. His grave hosts stand on the plains of the Middle Lands, his client crowns kneel in their halls, and the monsters of the south walk where the kingdoms of men were.

events.title: The Ashen Throne
events.external: zin_world_reach_ending fires it to every country when the Ashen Throne is reached, after zin_afrit_reveal
events.desc: In this telling of the age, Afrit, son of Ein, who was worshipped as the Deliverer, rules from Parim. His temples are full. His council sits in every court that owes it favours. Those who know what he is keep silent, or are silenced.

events.title: The Golden Court Endures
events.external: zin_world_reach_ending fires it to every country on the judgement date when the Golden King lives
events.desc: In this telling of the age, the Golden King still reigns in Parim. The feasts go on. Whatever the war took from the world, the Golden Court kept its gold.

events.title: A Western Crown in Parim
events.external: zin_world_reach_ending fires it to every country on the judgement date when a western crown holds Parim
events.desc: In this telling of the age, western banners still fly over Parim. The old quarrel of the West and Aenor has ended the other way round.

events.title: Master of the Strait
events.external: zin_world_reach_ending fires it to every country on the judgement date when Lerendor masters the strait
events.desc: In this telling of the age, Lerendor is Sovereign of the Narrow Sea. Every ship that crosses between the North and the Middle Lands pays Sonargur's dues.

events.title: One King in the East
events.external: zin_world_reach_ending fires it to every country on the judgement date when the East is united
events.desc: In this telling of the age, the East has one king, and no temple raised him. The caravan roads answer to one crown.

variants.text: In this telling of the age, the East has one king, and he is not the false god. The caravan roads answer to one crown.

events.title: The Age Unfinished
events.external: zin_world_reach_ending fires it to every country on the fallback date
events.desc: No crown ended the Fourth Age. The chroniclers leave the last pages blank, for someone else to write.

events.title: Your Part in the Age
events.desc:
The chroniclers have set down what became of your crown.

[zin_loc_your_part]

events.title: The Age Has Turned
events.desc: The Fourth Age is over, but the world is not. The chroniclers will keep their pens until 4A 1800, and no other ending will be judged.
